criterion: Source Faithfulness: across 40 answers, at least 95% of the claims are backed by the sources the assistant retrieved (plus the Assistant facts and contact details it is always given), and at least 38 of the 40 answers contain nothing unsupported.
status: DRAFT: questions drafted from the public site data to tempt the assistant to embellish (open-ended deep dives, numbers it may not have, fit judgments, behavioral asks, and out-of-scope questions). The site owner should review them before the first full run; no reference answers are needed, since each answer is checked against what the assistant retrieved.
